text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before we're supposed to run in the
Kyoto
Daishoten, a certain piece of news
drops.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow... So Suzuka managed to win the
Mainichi
Okan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is a powerful force in the
racing world. She's amassed a large
number of fans with her unreal speed,
earning her the nickname "Otherworldly
Front-Runner."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And she left Grass and El in the dust?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That sure is otherwordly. Tokyo Racecourse must have been raving.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess so... Yeah, we gotta end
big!
choice_data_list: Can't let them outdo us either!
We can't let them outdo us either!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really. It's just way more fun to
get other
people hyped.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If Suzuka used her speed to pull ahead,
that
means...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I can win if I use my special magic. ♪
Let's go
light up Kyoto!
